title: Fix trailing periods in generated document attachment folders
summary: Document attachment external storage now removes trailing periods from generated table folder names, so uploads for tables like Purch. Cr. Memo Hdr. are no longer rejected by SharePoint. An empty result falls back to Table_<TableID>.
key_points: Removes trailing periods from generated table folder names after reserved-character removal and truncation
Falls back to Table_<TableID> format when normalization results in an empty name
Applies normalization consistently across directory lookup, creation, and upload operations
Extends connector mock to capture directory paths for regression testing
Only affects newly generated folder names; existing folders and historical files remain unchanged
quote: Normalize generated table folders by removing trailing periods after the existing reserved-character removal, space conversion and 100-character truncation.
